role: Mechanical evidence addressing and declared-format checks only; no diagnosis, normative operational interpretation or gold access.

input.metadata_policy: Domain/role/operational prose and release ordinal are uninterpreted values; no operational field name is privileged.

source.common_format_statement: The capture and deployment records describe the same as_of snapshot. An immutable event ID has one payload. recorded_digest and recomputed_digest refer to identical captured bytes and must agree. Operational input/configuration records are observations of implementation behavior, not assurances of compliance with the contract. Version ordinals are release order, not proof of deployment.
source.reference: Public rendered evidence, capture_contract.data.rule; statically adopted generic format assumptions, never derived from gold. Operational contract prose is not parsed.
source.qualification: Check exact common statement in each fixture as a harness input qualification, not semantic parsing by compiler.

semantics.identity: Preserve original IDs and exact JSON values/types. No generated opaque IDs, case-ID lookup, family rules or expected value tables. Duplicated IDs are retained in indexes with ambiguity flags.
semantics.pointers: Inventory every node of every structured record data object, including root, nested objects, arrays, leaves. Relative pointer uses RFC6901 escaping and original array offsets; full pointer addresses the supplied raw case. Root is empty relative pointer and is explicitly a container, not a selected decisive field.
semantics.deployment: Collect concrete declared data.current_version values from deployment records. Resolve current_version only if all declarations are concrete equal strings and that ID has exactly one version declaration. Missing/UNKNOWN/conflicting/unresolved declarations leave current_version null with ambiguity. Never infer from release ordinal.
semantics.partition: Record version binding is top-level version, or for capture only data.deployment_version. If both exist and conflict, binding is unresolved. Known binding equal to resolved current version => current; another declared version => historical/non-current (not evidence of a defect); no binding => unversioned; unknown/undeclared/conflicting binding or unresolved current => unresolved. Return all four partitions.
semantics.unknown: Find every exact string UNKNOWN in each record, including metadata and nested data, using exact full pointer; never replace or infer it. Status from mechanical record binding.
semantics.events: Create record-to-event edges only for explicit execution_output.event_id or capture.data.immutable_event_id. Pair all linked output/capture records by equal concrete strings. Multiple matches are retained. No value similarity joins.
semantics.integrity: Adopt only generic capture invariants: all payloads explicitly claiming the same immutable event must agree; supplied recorded_digest and recomputed_digest must agree; capture deployment_version must agree with the declared current snapshot; linked output.version and capture.deployment_version must agree. No recomputation of digest bytes, operational text parser, currentness diagnosis or epistemic class.
semantics.comparison: Typed recursive comparison. UNKNOWN at either compared value gives unknown; any known unequal scalar/type/key-presence/array-length gives false with exact paths and values. Compare all payload claimant pairs (output/output, capture/capture, output/capture) sharing a concrete event ID. Missing required comparison inputs yields unknown. integrity_consistent=false if any supported invariant is false, else unknown if any is unknown or no checks, else true. It attests only checked declared format invariants.
semantics.provenance: Each finding retains exact record IDs and source field pointers. Each graph edge retains its explicit source fields and a reason from the contract. Missing links yield ambiguity, never a guessed edge.
semantics.input_output: For each execution_output, retain every execution_input with equal concrete explicit top-level version and finite numeric input.at < output.at. If both specify component_id, require equality. If both specify event_id, require equality. Missing input event_id does not imply causality. Zero/multiple candidates get missing/ambiguous flags. No nearest-input selection. Candidate links are not causal edges.
semantics.graph: Nodes: records (with their actual kind), declared versions, components and explicit events. Reference nodes for undeclared version/component IDs retain declared=false. Edges only declares_current_version, record_version, input_component, output_event, capture_event, capture_version, output_capture_same_event and candidate_input_output. No causes edge. Edge provenance includes all fields used for equality or chronology.
semantics.candidate_addressing: Expose all field entries and present operational/capture contract record IDs, plus explicit linked record IDs; do not rank candidates or emit a decisive field, required operational value, causal witness, sufficiency decision or final diagnosis.

normalization.order: Compiler sorts output collections deterministically. Actual source JSON pointers necessarily change under input-array reordering; comparison anchors /records/N, /components/N and /versions/N by original entity ID before comparing. Exact raw pointers remain in published outputs.
normalization.labels: Harness derives a bijection solely from evidence: sort entity arrays by ID-masked structural content, walk dictionary entries sorted by masked key/value, assign first-occurrence canonical tokens to opaque labels, including keys. Ambiguous masked structural ties fail normalization rather than consult metadata/gold. Compare all normalized compiler output fields. Raw IDs/values are never rewritten in compiler artifacts.
normalization.semantic_grouping: render-manifest case_id/label_map/order used only by fixture harness to group four public renderings and name output files, never passed to compiler. Representative is A/order1; all 80 renderings evaluated for 20 worlds.

dependency.compiler_interface: compile_evidence(case, contract) -> JSON value; pure function; stdlib json only
dependency.runtime: Dedicated python -I -S worker receives evidence/contract on stdin; module/stdlib loaded before lockdown; runtime audit hook denies every file open and subprocess/network/import activity. Compiler has no path, environment or repository interface.
dependency.audit: AST allowlist imports (json only), deny IO/reflection/dynamic evaluation calls, scan source for diagnostic labels, family tokens, case IDs and opaque literals; fail closed. Negative tests must reject attempted file access and forbidden imports/labels. Harness reads only rendered cases, render-manifest and engineering files during fixture execution. Preservation/audit Git operations are separate.

outcomes.pass_rule: All 20 worlds/80 renderings processed; independent mechanical inventory checks, all representation comparisons, all preregistered mutations, dependency boundary audit and byte replay pass. No diagnosis/classification metric.
outcomes.invalid_rule: Forbidden data access, mutation of frozen inputs or post-freeze implementation repair, missing fixture inventory or unhandled execution failure. Stop and preserve; no repair after engineering fixture run begins.
outcomes.limitations: A pass establishes only declared mechanical extraction on these reused public fixtures and synthetic mutations; no diagnostic capability, improved model score or hybrid architecture utility.
